tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App and page background behind surfaces.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels, modals, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, row hover, inset areas, neutral status chips.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines. Decorative only: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and select borders. Meets 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on canvas, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and table headers on canvas, surface and surface-sunken (6:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps, helper text on canvas, surface and surface-sunken (4.5:1 or better). Not for anything a user must read to act.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Brand color. Primary buttons, links, selection, focus ring, the mark. Text in cobalt reads on surface, canvas and cobalt-tint.

tokens.name: cobalt-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of cobalt fills and links.

tokens.name: on-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cobalt fill (7:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: cobalt-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active nav item, AI suggestion panels. Cobalt or ink text on it.

tokens.name: cobalt-soft
tokens.usage: Illustration and marketing graphics only. Never behind text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Final good outcomes only: Paid, Posted, Balanced, Healthy. Text on surface or success-tint.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of success chips and balance bars.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs a person: Needs review, Due soon, Partially paid, Degraded. Text on surface or warning-tint.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of warning chips and notices.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Money at risk or failure: Denied, Rejected, Overdue, Failed, Out of balance. Text on surface or danger-tint.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of danger chips, denied rows, destructive confirmations.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First data series. Single-series charts use only this.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second data series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third data series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth data series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series and 'Other'. Group anything beyond five here.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Website hero only. One per page.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Onboarding step titles, sign-in, empty-state headlines.

styles.name: title-m
styles.usage: Section and panel titles, modal titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Claims keep going out through Tebra's clearinghouse.
styles.usage: Running text, form fields, settings, onboarding.

styles.name: body-dense
styles.sample: Modifier 25 likely missing on the visit line
styles.usage: Tables, queue rows, side panels. Default in Compact density.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Auto-released by rule set v14 · 9:03 am

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small uppercase section labels inside panels. Never for buttons.

styles.name: figure-l
styles.usage: KPI tiles and report figures. Tabular figures always.

styles.name: figure-m
styles.usage: Header amounts on claim and remittance pages.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: CPT/HCPCS, ICD-10, modifiers, CARC/RARC, NPIs, trace and control numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between related items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding in the app, gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing in onboarding and settings.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Website section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Code chips, mode badges, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, the side panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals and the command palette.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips and count badges only.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the side panel, modals, toasts. Nothing else gets a shadow.
